# Random Memes

> random-memes is a random meme API for Node.js: a zero-dependency package and CLI that returns a random meme image from Lemmy meme communities, with TypeScript types.

Install with `npm install random-memes` (Node.js 20 or newer). Call `await random()` to get `{ image, category, caption, permalink }`; it works with `require` and with named ES module imports. `reddit()` is deprecated, fails with HTTP 403 in most environments and will be removed in v5.

## Docs

- [Usage](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/usage.html): installation, CommonJS, ES module and TypeScript usage, the CLI, error handling and upgrading from v3
- [random()](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/random.html): which Lemmy communities are used, caching, the return shape and when the call rejects
- [Meme API: Get Random Memes as JSON](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/meme-api.html): a real response, serving memes as JSON from your own HTTP server, the CLI and where the memes come from
- [reddit() (deprecated)](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/reddit.html): the deprecated subreddit method and its parameters
